sections.tldr: TL;DR: The Indira Gandhi National Open University online MCA is a UGC-DEB approved two-year Master of Computer Applications, delivered fully online. Indira Gandhi National Open University holds NAAC A++ accreditation. Specialisations include Software Development, Computer Applications, IT Management. It suits graduates who want a recognised MCA they can complete online. For the current confirmed fee and EMI options, speak with our counsellor, since the fee for this programme is verified case by case rather than published as a fixed table.

ugcDeb.heading: Indira Gandhi National Open University Online MCA: UGC-DEB Approval and Validity
ugcDeb.body: The UGC Distance Education Bureau regulates every online degree in India. Indira Gandhi National Open University is UGC-DEB entitled for online delivery, which means this MCA is valid for government and PSU recruitment, for private-sector employment, and for higher study at recognised Indian universities. Indira Gandhi National Open University also holds NAAC A++ accreditation. Always confirm the current entitlement for your admission year at deb.ugc.ac.in before you enrol.

abcId.heading: Academic Bank of Credits (ABC ID)
abcId.body: Every student in a UGC-approved online programme needs an Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) ID. You create it free on the ABC portal at abc.gov.in, usually through your DigiLocker account. As you clear each semester of the Indira Gandhi National Open University online MCA, your credits are deposited against this ID, which makes it easier to carry credits forward or move to senior developer and architect roles later. Keep the same ABC ID through the whole two-year programme.

redFlags.heading: What to Check Before You Enrol

flags.sentence1: Indira Gandhi National Open University does not publish a single fixed fee table for this online MCA.
flags.sentence2: Get the current fee and any EMI terms confirmed in writing before you pay, rather than relying on a figure quoted elsewhere.

flags.sentence1: This is a fully online programme with no on-campus classes.
flags.sentence2: If you want in-person teaching or a campus experience, this is not the right format for you.

flags.sentence1: Online study is self-driven and career support is not guaranteed.
flags.sentence2: Plan to build your own study routine, and expect to run your own job search after you graduate.

flags.sentence1: UGC-DEB entitlement is granted intake by intake.
flags.sentence2: Confirm that Indira Gandhi National Open University is on the current approved list at deb.ugc.ac.in for your admission year before you enrol.

faqs.question: Is the Indira Gandhi National Open University online MCA valid?
faqs.answer: Yes. Indira Gandhi National Open University is UGC-DEB entitled for online delivery and holds NAAC A++. The MCA is valid for employment, for government and PSU recruitment, and for higher study at recognised Indian universities. Confirm the current status at deb.ugc.ac.in.

faqs.question: Who can apply for the Indira Gandhi National Open University online MCA?
faqs.answer: You need a bachelor's degree with mathematics or computer science as studied at 10+2 or graduation level. The online format is built for people who want to study while they work. Confirm the exact cut-off with the university before applying.

faqs.question: How long is the Indira Gandhi National Open University online MCA?
faqs.answer: It is a two-year programme delivered fully online, which lets you study around work or other commitments.

faqs.question: What specialisations does the Indira Gandhi National Open University online MCA offer?
faqs.answer: Current specialisations include Software Development, Computer Applications, IT Management. The core curriculum, covering advanced software engineering, data structures, application development and modern computing, is the same across all of them, so choose the one that matches the role you want next. Confirm the live list with the university.

faqs.question: Who should consider the Indira Gandhi National Open University online MCA?
faqs.answer: It suits graduates who want a recognised MCA they can complete online, and carries local weight around New Delhi, Delhi. For the MCA you would study advanced software engineering, data structures, application development and modern computing, and typical early roles include software developer, web developer, system analyst. Many graduates go on to senior developer and architect roles.

faqs.question: What is the fee for the Indira Gandhi National Open University online MCA?
faqs.answer: The current confirmed fee is verified case by case rather than published as a fixed table. Speak with our counsellor for the latest fee and EMI options, and confirm the figure with the university in writing before you pay.
